description: PiFlip offline frequency catalog. Tier 1 = standardized US channel plans; Tier 2 = Cincinnati/Hamilton County OH from cited public sources (see SOURCES.md).

local_sources.title: RepeaterBook county lists (Hamilton, Butler, Clermont, Warren OH; Boone, Kenton, Campbell KY; Dearborn IN)
local_sources.covers: ham repeaters (one URL per county, loc= and state_id= vary: OH=39, KY=21, IN=18)

local_gaps: Repeater offsets: RepeaterBook list view shows only +/- sign; magnitudes filled with band-standard (0.6/1.6/5/25 MHz), 6m offset left null. Campbell KY and Dearborn IN tone columns were ambiguous in the fetched text (146.2 and 123.0 appeared in offset column) - verify. Pure DMR/D-STAR/P25/Fusion-only repeaters skipped (e.g. K8BIG 145.35 D-STAR, 147.09 P25, 443.9 DMR; WB8CRS 443.4 DMR; N8MFN 442.65 D-STAR; KD8VLU 442.9625 DMR; W8BLV 444.3625 DMR; WB8ZVL 443.15 P25; 444.425 Fusion; KA4OBT 442.7625 DMR; K4TCD 440.6 DMR). FM: radio-locator returned only the search form; FCC FM Query not fetched; Wikipedia 'List of radio stations in Ohio' extraction was unreliable so it was not used - list is from Media_in_Cincinnati only (formats may be dated). Airband: military UHF (360.85, 363.15, 254.25, 257.8, 243.0) omitted (outside typical usage/AM UHF); FAA chart supplement and LiveATC not checked. Public safety: RadioReference county page fetched OK; Cincinnati police/fire/county dispatch are on MARCS-IP P25 (one entry). Individual MARCS talkgroups/site freqs not listed. Northern KY (Kenton/Boone/Campbell) public safety not researched. RR data was extracted by a summarizer; spot-check tones.
